pages.text: Nothing on Titan is alive the way we are, but its chemistry moves. The $(thing)Tholin Drifter$() is a flake of the haze, carried on the slow wind (which turns with the day). Whoever it settles on is coated in tar: darkness, and heavy steps. It drops Tholin.

The $(thing)Catalyst Sprite$() is a speck of bare metal surface, and a catalyst speeds what is near it: it keeps five blocks off, and every three seconds spends half a minute of the oxygen in your rebreather and heals Titan's other creatures. Hurt, it keeps its distance. It sometimes drops a Nickel Catalyst.

The $(thing)Methane Skater$() stands on liquid methane as a pond skater does on water, skates straight out to whoever is on the shore and knocks them in. Its legs are coated against the methane: it can drop a Hydrophobic Coating. The $(thing)Cryolava Slug$() crawls the Sotra field, armoured and slow; it freezes what it touches and spits cryolava from twelve blocks.

Ruins: $(thing)Abandoned Refineries$() by the basin and the sea, $(thing)Lander Wrecks$() in the dunes and uplands, and $(thing)Cryolabs$() on the cryovolcanic plain. Each has a cache; a Cryolab's may hold Kekule's Dream.
